title: content/offices.yaml
description: The offices of the state. Field names follow the Office type in sim/Statecraft.Sim/Content.cs; a test keeps them equal.

checked.description: The day you opened the source.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Unique.

title.description: The official English title, as the player sees it.

title_he.description: The Hebrew title (#558) as a source gives it. Leave out when no source gives one (the UI keeps the English). Needs title_he_sources.

title_he_review.description: Review flag of title_he. agent-checked: an AI agent checked the name against its sources and no person has read it yet (CONTENT_POLICY section 2, rule 6; review in #564). Leave out once a native speaker has reviewed it.

title_he_f.description: The feminine Hebrew title, only where a woman held the office (the Knesset records write שרת העבודה). Needs title_he and title_he_f_sources.

title_he_f_review.description: Review flag of title_he_f. agent-checked: an AI agent checked the name against its sources and no person has read it yet (CONTENT_POLICY section 2, rule 6; review in #564). Leave out once a native speaker has reviewed it.

historical_only.description: Historical record only: no Cabinet seat, no player appointment, no gameplay.

several_holders.description: Several people may hold it on the same day (Minister without Portfolio, a second deputy minister). Such an office cannot appear in event text or own policies or effects, and the player cannot appoint to it.

from.description: Day the office was established (inclusive). Leave out if it exists from the start.

until.description: Day the office was abolished (exclusive). Leave out while it still exists.

successor.description: Id of the office that takes over (budget lines and policies) when this one is abolished: in office on the until day, one holder, not historical-only. Needs until. Leave out if none.
